name: 表单字段与主明细关系

workflow_bill.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[namelabel] AS [namelabel],[tablename] AS [tablename],[detailtablename] AS [detailtablename],[detailkeyfield] AS [detailkeyfield],[invalid] AS [invalid],[formdes] AS [formdes],[from_module_] AS [from_module_] FROM dbo.[workflow_bill] WHERE id IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1')

Workflow_billdetailtable.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[billid] AS [billid],[tablename] AS [tablename],[title] AS [title],[orderid] AS [orderid] FROM dbo.[Workflow_billdetailtable] WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1')

workflow_billfield.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[billid] AS [billid],[fieldname] AS [fieldname],[fieldlabel] AS [fieldlabel],[fielddbtype] AS [fielddbtype],[fieldhtmltype] AS [fieldhtmltype],[type] AS [type],[viewtype] AS [viewtype],[detailtable] AS [detailtable],[dsporder] AS [dsporder],[childfieldid] AS [childfieldid],[selectitem] AS [selectitem],[linkfield] AS [linkfield],[selectItemType] AS [selectitemtype],[pubchoiceId] AS [pubchoiceid],[pubchilchoiceId] AS [pubchilchoiceid],[fieldgroupid] AS [fieldgroupid],[isencrypt] AS [isencrypt] FROM dbo.[workflow_billfield] WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1')

workflow_formbase.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[formname] AS [formname] FROM dbo.[workflow_formbase] WHERE id IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')

workflow_formfield.sql: SELECT [formid] AS [formid],[fieldid] AS [fieldid],[fieldparameter] AS [fieldparameter],[ismultirows] AS [ismultirows],[fieldorder] AS [fieldorder],[isdetail] AS [isdetail],[groupId] AS [groupId],[fieldgroupid] AS [fieldgroupid] FROM dbo.[workflow_formfield] WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')

workflow_formdict.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[fieldname] AS [fieldname],[fielddbtype] AS [fielddbtype],[fieldhtmltype] AS [fieldhtmltype],[type] AS [type],[description] AS [description],[childfieldid] AS [childfieldid] FROM dbo.[workflow_formdict] WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0'))

workflow_formdictdetail.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[fieldname] AS [fieldname],[fielddbtype] AS [fielddbtype],[fieldhtmltype] AS [fieldhtmltype],[type] AS [type],[description] AS [description],[childfieldid] AS [childfieldid] FROM dbo.[workflow_formdictdetail] WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0'))

workflow_fieldlable.sql: SELECT [formid] AS [formid],[fieldid] AS [fieldid],[fieldlable] AS [fieldlable],[langurageid] AS [langurageid],[isdefault] AS [isdefault] FROM dbo.[workflow_fieldlable] WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')

workflow_SelectItem.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[fieldid] AS [fieldid],[isbill] AS [isbill],[selectvalue] AS [selectvalue],[selectname] AS [selectname],[listorder] AS [listorder],[isdefault] AS [isdefault],[childitemid] AS [childitemid],[cancel] AS [cancel],[pubid] AS [pubid] FROM dbo.[workflow_SelectItem] WHERE fieldid IN (SELECT id FROM dbo.workflow_billfield WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1') UNION SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0'))

workflow_browserurl.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[labelid] AS [labelid],[fielddbtype] AS [fielddbtype],[browserurl] AS [browserurl],[tablename] AS [tablename],[columname] AS [columname],[keycolumname] AS [keycolumname],[linkurl] AS [linkurl],[typeid] AS [typeid],[useable] AS [useable] FROM dbo.[workflow_browserurl] WHERE id IN (SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_billfield WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1') AND fieldhtmltype='3' UNION SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_formdict WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')) AND fieldhtmltype='3' UNION SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_formdictdetail WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')) AND fieldhtmltype='3')

workflow_browsertype.sql: SELECT [id] AS [id],[labelname] AS [labelname],[useable] AS [useable],[changeable] AS [changeable],[LABELID] AS [LABELID] FROM dbo.[workflow_browsertype] WHERE id IN (SELECT typeid FROM dbo.workflow_browserurl WHERE id IN (SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_billfield WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1') AND fieldhtmltype='3' UNION SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_formdict WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')) AND fieldhtmltype='3' UNION SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_formdictdetail WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')) AND fieldhtmltype='3'))

HtmlLabelInfo.sql: SELECT [indexid] AS [indexid],[languageid] AS [languageid],[labelname] AS [labelname] FROM dbo.[HtmlLabelInfo] WHERE languageid=7 AND indexid IN (SELECT fieldlabel FROM dbo.workflow_billfield WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1') UNION SELECT namelabel FROM dbo.workflow_bill WHERE id IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1') UNION SELECT labelid FROM dbo.workflow_browserurl WHERE id IN (SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_billfield WHERE billid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='1') AND fieldhtmltype='3' UNION SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_formdict WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')) AND fieldhtmltype='3' UNION SELECT [type] FROM dbo.workflow_formdictdetail WHERE id IN (SELECT fieldid FROM dbo.workflow_formfield WHERE formid IN (SELECT formid FROM dbo.workflow_base WHERE isbill='0')) AND fieldhtmltype='3'))
